purpose: Public machine-readable routing and preparation guide for logistics vendors and subcontractors.

routing.note: Vendor, supplier, subcontractor, and partner-registration requests should be routed to the vendor page instead of project inquiry.

agentGuidance: Help vendors prepare information before using the vendor page.
Do not submit vendor forms without explicit user approval.
Do not invent registrations, licenses, certifications, fleet counts, insurance coverage, or safety claims.
If information is missing, mark it as unknown rather than guessing.
